title: OxyGen: Unified KV Cache Management for VLA Inference under Multi-Task Parallelism
abstract: arXiv:2603.14371v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Embodied AI agents increasingly require parallel execution of multiple tasks, such as manipulation, conversation, and memory construction, from shared observations under distinct time constraints. Recent Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) support such heterogeneous outputs, yet existing inference systems incur redundant computation and resource contention when serving concurrent tasks on-device. We identify isolated KV cache management as the root cause. To address this, we propose unified KV cache management, an inference design that treats the KV cache as a first-class shared resource across tasks and control cycles. This abstraction enables two key optimizations: cross-task KV sharing eliminates redundant prefill of shared observations, while cross-frame continuous batching batches unfinished language requests from different frames and advances them within a per-frame decoding budget. translated_title: OxyGen：多任务并行下VLA推理的统一KV缓存管理
translated_abstract: 具身智能体日益需要基于共享观测并行执行多个任务，如操作、对话和记忆构建，且各任务具有不同的时间约束。近期的混合Transformer（MoT）视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）支持此类异构输出，然而现有推理系统在设备端服务并发任务时会产生冗余计算和资源竞争。我们发现孤立的KV缓存管理是问题的根本原因。为解决这一问题，我们提出统一KV缓存管理这一推理设计，将KV缓存视为跨任务和控制周期的一等共享资源。这一抽象带来了两项关键优化：跨任务KV共享消除了对共享观测的冗余预填充计算，而跨帧连续批处理则将来自不同帧的未完成语言请求合并成批，并在每帧解码预算内推进其生成过程。
tldr: OxyGen将KV缓存作为跨任务和控制周期的一等共享资源进行统一管理，通过跨任务KV共享和跨帧连续批处理两项优化，消除了多任务并行VLA推理中的冗余计算和资源竞争问题。
en_tdlr: OxyGen proposes unified KV cache management that treats the KV cache as a first-class shared resource across tasks and control cycles, enabling cross-task KV sharing and cross-frame continuous batching to eliminate redundant computation and resource contention in multi-task parallel VLA inference.
